intent.problem: A conversation agent needs a visible, auditable robot-simulation control surface that can complete one closed-loop goal without direct MuJoCo mutation, arbitrary browser automation, or cross-run command replay.
intent.target_users: Robotics demonstrators, AI-agent developers, simulation researchers, and evaluators.

product.benefit: Lets an OtterDesk user move, inspect, send a visible Microduck toward an active ball, or let it repeatedly find and kick the ball in ordinary language without granting raw simulator, shell, or browser-control access.
product.customizable_for: Interactive robotics demonstrations, agent-tool evaluation, browser-based simulation control, and bounded closed-loop navigation prototypes.
product.how_it_works: Builds and serves the bundled Vite simulator, grants one ?control=1 browser tab a lease, indexes the same manual exposed by MCP, lets the default Job model select one validated effect per turn, and runs find-ball and free-play requests through deterministic position-feedback controllers.
product.input: The bundled demo input folder, one local browser control tab, and natural-language requests in OtterDesk.
product.output: A visual simulator URL, compact live service state, command receipts/history, and a final run artifact.
product.problem: Conversation agents need an auditable way to act in a web robot simulator without direct MuJoCo state mutation or unbounded browser automation.
product.simulation_type: One browser-owned Microduck MuJoCo simulation controlled through bounded primitive effects, deterministic active-ball approach, and stoppable continuous free play.
product.target_users: Robotics demonstrators, AI-agent developers, simulation researchers, and evaluators.

overview: Talk to a live Microduck MuJoCo simulation in OtterDesk: the Job agent interprets natural-language intent and invokes bounded MCP movement, goal-directed ball navigation, continuous free play, routine, locomotion, ball, reset, stop, and state tools.
